item.title: Barcelona vs Real Madrid 2026 live stream: Time, TV channels and how to watch El Clasico online
item.description: Real Madrid visit Barcelona in the first El Clásico of the 2026-27 season. Los Blancos are currently six points behind Barça in the table, which means that they must avoid losing this game if they want to keep their title hopes alive. Madrid will be without goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois, who initially made the squad list but had to be removed from it due to the flu. Lunin will play in his absence. PREDICTED LINEUPS: Barcelona predicted XI: Joan García; Xavi Espart, Cubarsí, Gerard Martín, Cancelo; Pedri, Rodri; Lamine Yamal, Fermín López, Adeyemi; Raphinha. Real Madrid predicted XI: Lunin; Valverde, Konaté, Huijsen, Cucurella; Tchouaméni, Camavinga; Güler, Bellingham, Diomande; Mbappé. Available Streaming : ESPN+ (USA)

item.title: Osaka 'not far off' her best but often ponders future
item.description: Naomi Osaka's last Grand Slam title came at the Australian Open in February 2021 [Getty Images] Naomi Osaka says she is "not far off" the form that saw her win four Grand Slam titles, but admits she has thought about quitting and often ponders her future. The 29-year-old Japanese star twice won both the US Open and Australian Open, between 2018 and 2021, during a glittering start to her career that saw her rise to number one in the world. But she took time out of the sport in 2021 to prioritise her mental health and another 15 months away after becoming pregnant, before returning in 2023 following the birth of her daughter. Osaka now says that she would quit tennis if her three-year-old, Shai, asked her to, despite climbing back up the world rankings and once again challenging for major titles. "It's tough, sometimes I look towards my future and I often wonder how long I'm going to play," said Osaka, as she prepares to take part in the Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo. "Because if my daughter did say she didn't want me to travel as much, I'm not the type of person to ignore that." 'I'm very proud of myself' - Osaka wins on comeback Osaka withdraws from French Open Osaka beats Brady to win Australian Open Osaka acknowledged that her mindset has changed a lot with age and the extra responsibilities that come with parenthood, saying "my daughter is my biggest priority". "I try my best to put as much energy as I can into tennis," she added. "I wouldn't say I'm part-timing it but my entire day doesn't consist of that. "If I think about it in certain ways, I'm really proud of where I am now because it's not like I can dedicate my entire time to the sport." Osaka has battled her way back up to 19th in the world and is the seventh seed at this week's tournament, where she plays Italy's Jasmine Paolini in the opening round. She beat top seed Aryna Sabalenka on her way to the quarter-finals of Wimbledon earlier this year, after finishing runner-up in the preceding grass tournament at Bad Homberg, and also reached the last 16 of the French Open and US Open . Osaka also made it to the semi-finals in Washington and last eight in Toronto during the North American hardcourt swing, and her run at Flushing Meadows was only ended by eventual champion Elena Rybakina. "I genuinely don't feel like I'm that far off," she said, when considering if she can get back to winning titles. "I think there are certain instincts that I don't want to say I lost, but maybe I forgot and I'm kind of relearning but yeah, I don't think - I hope - I'm not far off. "I think I built a pretty solid base and I'm just excited to see if I can continue learning and going further in tournaments." item.title: Kentucky Wildcats in the College Football Rankings Roundup and Sunday News
item.description: Kentucky took car of business last night at home, defeating Vancderbilt 34-17 to give the Wildcats a 7-1 record and 5-1 mark in SEC play heading into a much-needed bye week. Coming off multiple weeks where Kentucky was a touchdown or more underdog, the Cats entered last night as a favorite against Vanderbilt. Despite falling down 10-0 to start the game, the Cats came back and handled the Commodores for the remainder of the game. Kenny Minchey played well for the Cats, and Kenny Darby, Willie Rodriguez, and DJ Miller came up big on offense as well. Defensively, the Cats were able to force a pair of key turnovers in the second half to secure the win. Kentucky entered last night ranked 12th in both the AP and Coaches Poll, and after multiple teams ranked ahead of them lost yesterday, we should see some notable movement within the polls. Chip Patterson at CBS Sports projects Kentucky to move up to #9 in this week’s rankings. Thomas Goldkamp over at ON3 also projects Kentucky to land at #9. Bleacher Report’s rankings also have Kentucky at #9. The rankings will definitely have a major shakeup after another chaotic college football Saturday. Where do you think Kentucky will land? Tweet of the Day This was NOT called pass interference on Vanderbilt. The defender clearly makes contact with the receiver before the ball arrives preventing him from making a play on the ball. That’s a BAD missed call that stopped Kentucky’s drive. pic.twitter.com/JHACCm2gXf — That’s A Bad Call (@BadCallOfficial) October 25, 2026 I know Kentucky ended up winning, but can we talk about those missed pass interference calls?! item.title: Serie A Liveblog: Inter-Fiorentina, Lecce-Juventus, Udinese-Milan and more
item.description: Serie A Liveblog: Inter-Fiorentina, Lecce-Juventus, Udinese-Milan and more Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from today’s five Serie A games: Inter-Fiorentina, Genoa-Venezia, Atalanta-Frosinone, Lecce-Juventus, and Udinese-Milan. We begin at 12:30 CET [11:30 GMT] with Inter hosting Fiorentina at San Siro. The Nerazzurri need a win to catch Lazio at the top of the Serie A table after Gennaro Gattuso’s side beat Parma 2-1 on Saturday. The afternoon games, both starting at 15:00 CET, are Genoa-Venezia and Atalanta-Frosinone. Only one point separates Venezia and Genoa after the Lagunari won their first match under Davide Nicola last week. Venezia remain bottom of the league with three points, but Parma, Fiorentina, Genoa and Udinese are just one point above them. Juventus visit Eusebio Di Francesco’s Lecce at 18:00 CET, and Serie A Week 8 ends at 20:45 with Milan’s away game at Udinese. Juventus have earned just five points in their last five Serie A matches, with two draws, two defeats, and one win. Milan, on the other hand, remain unbeaten in Serie A but have managed just two wins and three draws in their last five.

item.title: Is Jordan Mason playing today? Injury update, start or sit advice for Week 7
item.description: The Minnesota Vikings entered the week with hope that they could be getting a reinforcement back at running back in Jordan Mason . Mason, who had been on injured reserve since Week 2 because of a thumb injury, was designated to return from injured reserve this past week. Upon returning to practice, Mason was able to log three full practices before drawing a questionable tag for Sunday afternoon. Here’s the latest on Mason’s status for the Sunday matchup versus the Indianapolis Colts in Week 7. MORE: NFL House closes in Paris amid protests Is Jordan Mason playing today? Minnesota Vikings running back Jordan Mason (27) rushes the ball against the Washington Commanders during the first half at U.S. Bank Stadium. Credit: Brad Rempel-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Mason was officially activated off injured reserve on Saturday, the team announced. And, as a result, ESPN’s Adam Schefter reports that Mason is expected to play in Week 7. “Vikings activated RB Jordan Mason off injured reserve to their 53-man roster and he is expected to play Sunday vs. the Colts,” Schefter wrote. MORE: Bold predictions for NFL Week 7 Now, one has to wonder just how much of a workload Mason will get in his first game back, as it’s possible he could be limited on top of his splitting work with fellow back Aaron Jones. Going into Sunday morning, there hasn’t been any reporting regarding how much work Mason will see. Jordan Mason start or sit advice Minnesota Vikings running back Jordan Mason (27) before the game against the Denver Broncos at Empower Field at Mile High. Credit: Isaiah J. Downing-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Mason saw a healthy 15 carries in his first and only game this season back in Week 1. However, it’s possible the Vikings might work Mason back in slowly after he was out over a month due to his thumb injury. At the very least, according to ESPN’s Kevin Seifert , Mason is “expected to split time against the Indianapolis Colts with teammate Aaron Jones Sr.,” which we saw in the season-opener, when Mason took 15 carries to Jones’ 12. MORE: Joe Buck snapped at ‘cold, difficult’ Troy Aikman during heated conversation Complicating this decision even more is the fact that Mason draws a very favorable matchup against a Colts defense permitting the sixth-most fantasy points per game to running backs this season, according to CBS Sports . That said, short of an update that tells us Mason is going to see a regular workload, it’s hard to trust him in lineups with that uncertainty. We’re keeping Mason on the bench this week in order to see how things shake out. Verdict: Sit — Enjoy free coverage of the top news & trending stories with The Big Lead Newsletter —

item.title: Arsenal 24yo picked up new injury vs Everton
item.description: Arsenal 24yo picked up new injury vs Everton Mikel Arteta has confirmed that Riccardo Calafiori picked up an injury issue during Arsenal’s win over Everton, but the manager has played down the severity of the problem. Photo by Alex Pantling/Getty Images Towards the end of Arsenal’s win over Everton , some fans and reporters noted that Noni Madueke appeared to have taken over Riccardo Calafiori’s left-back role. Calafiori then went straight down the tunnel at the full-time whistle, leading to speculation that the defender could have an injury. Speaking in his post-match press conference, Mikel Arteta confirmed as much, but added that it doesn’t appear to be serious. “He had a light issue, we’re not quite sure what it is, something very small, but he was cautious of that,” Arteta said . Photo by Alex Pantling/Getty Images The frustration will be that Arsenal had opted to rest Calafiori from the start of the game, only bringing him on for the last quarter, and yet he picked up an injury anyway. But as long as the problem is nothing too serious, Arteta could easily play it safe and give Calafiori another rest against Fleetwood Town in midweek. Piero Hincapie has just returned from injury, and he could probably do with some minutes. The Fleetwood League Cup game is a good opportunity to help him build up his fitness, and Myles Lewis-Skelly should be available when Hincapie needs a break. Photo by Justin Setterfield/Getty Images The concern is more for next weekend’s game against Liverpool. Arsenal will want their very best side available for the trip to Anfield, and they’re already almost certain to be without William Saliba and Bukayo Saka . There’s more hope around Christos Tzolis’ situation, but little certainty at this stage. The Gunners just won’t want anyone other than those three to miss the next big Premier League fixture. Photo by Clive Rose/Getty Images

item.title: 'Strange!' - Arsenal legend Martin Keown slams Xabi Alonso tactics after Chelsea suffer shock Tottenham defeat
item.description: FBL-ENG-PR-CHELSEA-TOTTENHAM - AFP Martin Keown has questioned Xabi Alonso's surprising tactical decisions following Chelsea's disappointing 2-0 home defeat against Tottenham. The former Arsenal defender could not understand why the manager opted for a false nine setup rather than deploying an experienced striker from the bench. Spurs secure rare Stamford Bridge win Tottenham secured a rare 2-0 victory over Chelsea at Stamford Bridge on Saturday evening. It marked only their second league win at the stadium in 36 years. A back-up goalkeeper's own goal from a corner gave the visitors the initial lead. Mathys Tel then put the game firmly to bed with a brilliant solo strike to seal the three points. Chelsea endured a miserable afternoon across the pitch. Cole Palmer was sent off between the two Tottenham goals, capping off a frustrating London derby for the hosts. Keown questions strange tactical gamble Chelsea manager Alonso opted to start Morgan Rogers in a false nine role against Tottenham. The decision came after in-form forward Joao Pedro picked up a training injury during the week. Arsenal legend Keown heavily criticised this setup on BBC's Match of the Day . He believed the tactical tweak completely backfired and hindered Chelsea's attacking threat. "That seemed strange, it seemed strange" Keown said regarding the starting line-up. "I don't remember Morgan Rogers ever playing up front for Aston Villa and I didn't think he was at his best at all today." Welbeck left waiting on the bench The decision to play Rogers out of position was amplified by Alonso's available substitutes. The Chelsea boss had experienced Premier League striker Danny Welbeck ready on the bench. Welbeck was only introduced late in the match when the hosts were already chasing the game. Keown admitted he was completely baffled by this selection choice given the lack of a natural striker on the pitch. "We all know what Danny Welbeck can offer and what he can bring," Keown added. "They used him late on in the match but I can't really understand why he didn't start." Crucial cup clash awaits Chelsea Alonso must quickly lift his squad following the painful London derby defeat. Chelsea return to action on Wednesday night in a high-profile cup fixture. The team will face Liverpool in the fourth round of the EFL Cup. It offers an immediate opportunity to bounce back and find their goalscoring form. Meanwhile, Tottenham have a full week to prepare for their next challenge. They return to Premier League action next weekend against London rivals Crystal Palace.

item.title: 🚨 Thuram, Esposito, Mastantuono: Inter-Fiorentina line-ups are out
item.description: 🚨 Thuram, Esposito, Mastantuono: Inter-Fiorentina line-ups are out Sunday's action on Serie A matchday eight kicks off with a blockbuster clash between Inter and Fiorentina at San Siro. The league leaders host a Viola side who have picked up just one point from a possible nine since Vanoli took charge. With Lautaro Martínez a notable absentee, here are the line-ups for today's game in Milan: Inter : Provedel; Bisseck, Akanji, Bastoni; Diouf, Barella, Çalhanoglu, Mkhitaryan, Carlos Augusto; Thuram, Pio Esposito. Chivu names an unsurprising starting XI, with Thuram and Esposito leading the line. Fiorentina : De Gea; Alejandro Jiménez, Dragusin, Pongracic, Valdepeñas; Ndour, Fagioli, Brescianini; Mastantuono, Pellegrino, Njie. For the Viola, Valdepeñas features, with Mastantuono and Pellegrino playing behind Njie up front. Oulai ultimately misses out on the starting XI. item.title: Raiders star Maxx Crosby can’t believe Kirk Cousins wants to ‘beat up an innocent animal’
item.description: Photo by Michael Owens/Getty Images Las Vegas Raiders QB Kirk Cousins’ massive take leaves Maxx Crosby stunned. The Las Vegas Raiders currently have a 3-3 record in the 2026-27 NFL season as veteran QB Kirk Cousins has cooled off following a hot start to the campaign. But let’s put Cousins’ performance on the field on the back burner and focus on what the 38-year-old said about potentially facing an animal in a fight. Maxx Crosby can’t believe Kirk Cousins thinks he can beat a panda in a fight The Raiders’ official Instagram handle shared a hilarious video featuring Cousins and DE Maxx Crosby, where they were asked which animal they think can beat them in a fight. “I will take down a panda if he’s not gonna fight back,” Cousins said with confidence. But Crosby expressed his doubts, stating: “Bro, a panda is a bear.” Despite that, Cousins didn’t budge from his answer and reiterated: “Yeah. But if he’s just gonna sit there and take it.” Crosby was still stunned and asked the star QB, “So you’re just gonna beat up an innocent animal in the forest?” Crosby continued his defence of bears, stating he’s a huge panda guy before claiming he can defeat an ostrich in a fight. Of course, the discussion was hypothetical, as either Raiders star would likely face a huge defeat against a panda or an ostrich. item.title: Phillies Cut Ties With 11-Year MLB Shortstop After Disappointing Season
item.description: PHILADELPHIA, PA - AUGUST 29: The Phillies logo at section 108 seat 32 is shown at Citizens Bank Park on August 29, 2017 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Rain cancelled the game against the Atlanta Braves and is rescheduled as a doubleheader tomorrow. (Photo by Corey Perrine/Getty Images) Getty Images The Philadelphia Phillies entered the season hoping to make another deep postseason run, but their year ended sooner than expected. Now, the organization faces questions about how to get back on track, particularly with a veteran roster that leaves limited room for sweeping personnel changes. Philadelphia has already begun looking beyond its major-league lineup for answers. Defensive struggles contributed to the team’s disappointing campaign, prompting recent changes that extended beyond the dugout and into its player-development system. “The Phillies permitted a .274 batting average on groundballs in 2026; only the A’s were higher,” Matt Gelb noted for The Athletic . “The league average against was .249. If the Phillies were just average at converting grounders into outs, it would have saved them 46 hits over the season.” After the harsh performance and with little room to maneuver on the payroll, the Phillies dismissed numerous members of the organization, including a highly regarded retired shortstop who played for 11 years in the big leagues. And those developments might have obscured the update that the organization was also cutting ties with Adam Everett, who served as Philadelphia’s minor-league infield coordinator for five seasons. “Adam Everett, who had been the infield coordinator for five seasons and lauded for improving prospect Aidan Miller’s work at shortstop, was not retained,” Gelb reported. Everett’s departure is part of a broader organizational shakeup following a season in which Philadelphia struggled to turn groundballs into outs. The Phillies are looking for ways to improve their defensive results, and that effort includes reassessing the personnel responsible for developing young players. And the decision is notable given Everett’s background as a defensive specialist during his playing career. “Everett played 11 major league seasons with the (Houston) Astros (2001–2007), (Minnesota) Twins (2008), (Detroit) Tigers (2009–2010), and (Cleveland) Indians (2011), finishing with a .242 career average, 40 home runs, and 283 RBI,” Chuck Hixson reported for Philly Baseball News . “Known for his glove, he was the starting shortstop on Houston’s 2005 World Series team and won the Fielding Bible Award as baseball’s best fielding shortstop in 2006.” Everett’s experience gives his

(Photo by Corey Perrine/Getty Images) Getty Images The Philadelphia Phillies entered the season hoping to make another deep postseason run, but their year ended sooner than expected. Now, the organization faces questions about how to get back on track, particularly with a veteran roster that leaves limited room for sweeping personnel changes. Philadelphia has already begun looking beyond its major-league lineup for answers. Defensive struggles contributed to the team’s disappointing campaign, prompting recent changes that extended beyond the dugout and into its player-development system. “The Phillies permitted a .274 batting average on groundballs in 2026; only the A’s were higher,” Matt Gelb noted for The Athletic . “The league average against was .249. If the Phillies were just average at converting grounders into outs, it would have saved them 46 hits over the season.” After the harsh performance and with little room to maneuver on the payroll, the Phillies dismissed numerous members of the organization, including a highly regarded retired shortstop who played for 11 years in the big leagues. FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Yankees Moving On From $90 Million 2-Time All-Star Contract, Opening Payroll Philadelphia Phillies Make Changes To Infield Development After Dissapointing Season Earlier this month, news surfaced that the Phillies would retain manager Don Mattingly, while cutting ties with long-time hitting coach Kevin Long and infield coach Bobby Dickerson. And those developments might have obscured the update that the organization was also cutting ties with Adam Everett, who served as Philadelphia’s minor-league infield coordinator for five seasons. “Adam Everett, who had been the infield coordinator for five seasons and lauded for improving prospect Aidan Miller’s work at shortstop, was not retained,” Gelb reported. Everett’s departure is part of a broader organizational shakeup following a season in which Philadelphia struggled to turn groundballs into outs. The Phillies are looking for ways to improve their defensive results, and that effort includes reassessing the personnel responsible for developing young players. And the decision is notable given Everett’s background as a defensive specialist during his playing career. “Everett played 11 major league seasons with the (Houston) Astros (2001–2007), (Minnesota) Twins (2008), (Detroit) Tigers (2009–2010), and (Cleveland) Indians (2011), finishing with a .242 career average, 40 home runs, and 283 RBI,” Chuck Hixson reported for Philly Baseball News . “Known for his glove, he was the starting shortstop on Houston’s 2005 World Series team and won the Fielding Bible Award as baseball’s best fielding shortstop in 2006.” Everett’s experience gives his departure added significance as the Phillies try to improve their infield defense. His work with Miller, one of the organization’s notable prospects, also makes the change relevant to Philadelphia’s longer-term plans. FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Dodgers Urged To Trade Shohei Ohtani After Injury Setback Philadelphia Phillies Continue Organizational Overhaul Everett was not the only minor-league coordinator to depart. The Phillies also moved on from outfield coordinator Andy Abad, who had spent 15 years with the organization, according to Gelb. Those decisions follow changes to the major-league coaching staff, underscoring the organization’s willingness to reconsider its approach after a disappointing season. Philadelphia cannot easily rebuild its roster, given the commitments it has made to veteran players. Improving the development of its younger talent and finding ways to prevent defensive mistakes could therefore be important parts of its effort to return to postseason contention. item.title: Why Madueke Ended Up at Left-Back as Arteta Confirms Injury Concern
item.description: Why Madueke Ended Up at Left-Back as Arteta Confirms Injury Concern Three points, another clean sheet and Arsenal level with Manchester City at the top of the Premier League. Saturday’s 2-0 victory over Everton gave us plenty to celebrate, Gooners! But there was one rather strange sight towards the end of the game. Why on earth was Noni Madueke playing at left-back while Riccardo Calafiori had moved further forward? At first glance, it looked like an unusual tactical decision from Mikel Arteta. However, the Arsenal manager has now revealed that an injury concern was behind the unexpected switch. Arteta Explains Madueke’s Unusual Positional Switch Calafiori started on the bench against Everton, with Myles Lewis-Skelly taking his place at left-back. The Italian was introduced during the second half as Arsenal looked to build on their early advantage, but towards the closing stages, something clearly wasn’t quite right. Madueke, who had been particularly lively in his attacking role, suddenly found himself defending on the opposite flank. Asked about the decision in his post-match press conference , Arteta explained: “It was because he had a slight issue, we don’t know what it is, it seems to be something very small,” The manager also explained that Calafiori had been cautious about the problem. That’s hopefully reassuring news, although we don’t yet know exactly what the issue is or whether it could affect his availability. (Photo by Clive Rose/Getty Images) Another Injury Concern for Arsenal’s Growing List? It’s certainly not ideal timing. We’re already facing an extended spell without Bukayo Saka , while William Saliba and Christos Tzolis have also been recovering from injuries. And Calafiori wasn’t the only defender giving us a scare against Everton. Gabriel required treatment during the second half, raising concerns among supporters, but thankfully continued and went on to score our second goal. As we saw in yesterday’s 2-0 victory over Everton , Arteta has been making good use of his squad, and having alternatives available is becoming increasingly important. Piero Hincapié has recently returned from his ankle injury, while Lewis-Skelly offers another option at left-back. Hopefully, Calafiori’s problem really is as minor as Arteta suggested. With fixtures coming thick and fast, we can ill afford to lose another important player, particularly when we’re trying to maintain momentum in the title race. What do you think, Gooners? Are you concerned about Arsenal’s growing injury problems? item.title: What Cameron Young said about Brooks Koepka returning as it’s revealed he agreed to join LIV himself
item.description: Photo by Tracy Wilcox/PGA TOUR via Getty Images One of the more intriguing pieces of news to emerge from LIV Golf’s bankruptcy hearings in recent days concerned Cameron Young. Cameron Young is now one of the best players on the PGA Tour , having won The Players Championship and finished in the top-three at two of the four majors in 2026. However, history could have been very different for the 29-year-old. It was revealed this week that Young had actually reached an agreement with LIV Golf to join the league back in 2022, one week after finishing second to Cam Smith at The Open Championship . It is not clear what convinced Young to stay with the PGA Tour. He did play in the Presidents Cup later that year, but he would have to wait another three years to win on the PGA Tour for the very first time. Young would have almost certainly not been the only player to agree a deal with LIV before backing out. But his decision does make his perspective on what happens next much more interesting. What Cameron Young said about Brooks Koepka returning to the PGA Tour after his LIV Golf exit Of course, the PGA Tour welcomed Brooks Koepka back earlier this year. Meanwhile, there has been speculation throughout the season concerning the future of LIV. Speaking to ESPN back in May, Young was asked about having Koepka back, as well as the possibility of more LIV players returning in the future. “I feel like it’s a little bit tricky. I think it’s been great to have Brooks back. He’s a fan favourite, he’s a great golfer, great major championship player, so I’m happy to have him back. I think it’s good for the PGA Tour, I think it’s good for the game to get to see him more. The tour did have the system that they put in place for him. They had the opportunity this January for some of those guys, the select few, to come back, and Brooks was the only one to take that opportunity,” he said. “It’s not up to me, but I think the PGA Tour, I imagine they’ll find a way for some of those guys to come back, but I don’t know if it will be as simple as it was for Brooks. Time-wise, he didn’t have to sit out or anything like that, so I really have no good information on what will happen, but all in all I play golf to play golf against the best players in the world. That’s one of the main things that drives me is to compete. To me, there’s a handful of really, really good players that are over there, and seeing them four times a year I probably would rather compete against them more. “If you’re asking me, I’d probably like to see them back in some capacity however they decide it’s going to work out. And you’d like it to be fair to both sides, I don’t think there’s any reason to unduly punish them coming back. But at the same time, it felt like an all or nothing decision to go. It’s up to people smarter than me to figure it all out.” Cameron Young has been vindicated for snubbing LIV Golf after agreeing a deal Obviously, Young’s trajectory would have been completely different had he d

Cameron Young is now one of the best players on the PGA Tour , having won The Players Championship and finished in the top-three at two of the four majors in 2026. However, history could have been very different for the 29-year-old. He did play in the Presidents Cup later that year, but he would have to wait another three years to win on the PGA Tour for the very first time. What Cameron Young said about Brooks Koepka returning to the PGA Tour after his LIV Golf exit Of course, the PGA Tour welcomed Brooks Koepka back earlier this year. Meanwhile, there has been speculation throughout the season concerning the future of LIV. Speaking to ESPN back in May, Young was asked about having Koepka back, as well as the possibility of more LIV players returning in the future. “I feel like it’s a little bit tricky. I think it’s been great to have Brooks back. He’s a fan favourite, he’s a great golfer, great major championship player, so I’m happy to have him back. I think it’s good for the PGA Tour, I think it’s good for the game to get to see him more. The tour did have the system that they put in place for him. They had the opportunity this January for some of those guys, the select few, to come back, and Brooks was the only one to take that opportunity,” he said. “It’s not up to me, but I think the PGA Tour, I imagine they’ll find a way for some of those guys to come back, but I don’t know if it will be as simple as it was for Brooks. Time-wise, he didn’t have to sit out or anything like that, so I really have no good information on what will happen, but all in all I play golf to play golf against the best players in the world. That’s one of the main things that drives me is to compete. To me, there’s a handful of really, really good players that are over there, and seeing them four times a year I probably would rather compete against them more. “If you’re asking me, I’d probably like to see them back in some capacity however they decide it’s going to work out. And you’d like it to be fair to both sides, I don’t think there’s any reason to unduly punish them coming back. But at the same time, it felt like an all or nothing decision to go. It’s up to people smarter than me to figure it all out.” Cameron Young has been vindicated for snubbing LIV Golf after agreeing a deal Obviously, Young’s trajectory would have been completely different had he decided to go through with signing with LIV back in 2022. He may well have had more immediate success when you consider that he did not win on the PGA Tour until 2025. However, Young must be delighted with where he is right now, with a major championship victory surely the next step in his career. He has top-five finishes at each of the four majors across his career. Meanwhile, he was a star at both the 2025 Ryder Cup and the Presidents Cup in September. In hindsight, signing with LIV appeared to put a much lower ceiling on a lot of players. Very few will leave with evidence to show that they are better players than when they joined, though their bank balances should certainly soften the blow. Had Young made the jump, he may well have won much sooner. But he will surely reflect now that he made the right decision when he chose to stay with the PGA Tour.

item.title: $3 million Texas WR under fire for dropping incredible Arch Manning pass before leaving game with injury
item.description: Photo by David Buono/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Texas Longhorns WR Cam Coleman received a lot of criticism for ruining an incredible Arch Manning passing highlight by dropping an easy pass. Manning found the perfect TD pass opportunity when he threw a dart over the Ole Miss defence into the hands of star WR Coleman, who had an open field ahead of him to convert the TD. Unfortunately, Coleman could not hold onto the pass despite not being under pressure from surrounding defenders in an embarrassing highlight that had college football fans fuming about the WR’s price tag after his offseason transfer. Cam Coleman receives fan hate for dropping Arch Manning pass With under five minutes left in the first quarter, Manning threw a perfect deep ball to an open Coleman, who missed out on a potential 59-yard TD conversion. Fans were fuming with Coleman after his highly anticipated summer transfer from Auburn. “Literally cannot throw a better football than this,” lamented one fan . “One of the most overrated receivers we will legit ever see in CFB,” said a fan . “Texas paid Cam Coleman 3 million to catch passes lmao,” said a fan in shock over his NIL value . “Everyone wants to talk about Arch; no one wants to talk about Cam Coleman,” were the thoughts of another fan . “He’s garbage and has been garbage, not sure why he was getting gas this offseason,” questioned one fan . “Cam Coleman is the Justin Herbert of college football wide receivers,” said another fan . Coleman has a $3 million NIL valuation according to On3Sports, which would be the second-highest for any receiver in the NCAA, only behind Heisman favourite Jeremiah Smith. In seven games this season, Coleman has 21 receptions for 348 yards and six touchdowns. He left the 34-27 win over Ole Miss after injuring his shoulder on an attempted catch in the second half. Coleman did return to the sideline but was in street clothes, putting a real question mark over when he will be ready to return. Given the fact THAT he has not been one of Texas’s premier WR targets all season, and he is now potentially going to be out with an injury, this season might be more challenging for Coleman than he initially anticipated after switching schools over the offseason. Manning found the perfect TD pass opportunity when he threw a dart over the Ole Miss defence into the hands of star WR Coleman, who had an open field ahead of him to convert the TD. Unfortunately, Coleman could not hold onto the pass despite not being under pressure from surrounding defenders in an embarrassing highlight that had college football fans fuming about the WR’s price tag after his offseason transfer. Cam Coleman receives fan hate for dropping Arch Manning pass With under five minutes left in the first quarter, Manning threw a perfect deep ball to an open Coleman, who missed out on a potential 59-yard TD conversion. Fans were fuming with Coleman after his highly anticipated summer transfer from Auburn. “Literally cannot throw a better football than this,” lamented one fan . “One of the most overrated receivers we will legit ever see in CFB,” said a fan . “Texas paid Cam Coleman 3 million to catch passes lmao,” said a fan in shock over his NIL value . “Everyone wants to talk about Arch; no one wants to talk about Cam Coleman,” were the thoughts of another fan . “He’s garbage and has been garbage, not sure why he was getting gas this offseason,” questioned one fan . “Cam Coleman is the Justin Herbert of college football wide receivers,” said another fan . Coleman has a $3 million NIL valuation according to On3Sports, which would be the second-highest for any receiver in the NCAA, only behind Heisman favourite Jeremiah Smith. In seven games this season, Coleman has 21 receptions for 348 yards and six touchdowns. He left the 34-27 win over Ole Miss after injuring his shoulder on an attempted catch in the second half. Coleman did return to the sideline but was in street clothes, putting a real question mark over when he will be ready to return. Given the fact THAT he has not been one of Texas’s premier WR targets all season, and he is now potentially going to be out with an injury, this season might be more challenging for Coleman than he initially anticipated after switching schools over the offseason. item.title: Juventus star considers leaving as he still cannot get game time
item.description: Juventus star considers leaving as he still cannot get game time Federico Gatti was handed a rare starting opportunity against Rennes in the Europa League in midweek, but his appearance ended before the final whistle after he was substituted following a yellow card. The decision was frustrating for the Italian defender, who had expected to remain on the pitch until the end of the match. Despite his importance to the squad, Gatti has struggled to secure regular minutes in recent weeks. Juventus continue to regard him as one of their valuable players, particularly because of his leadership qualities and influence within the dressing room. However, competition for places in defence has made it difficult for him to establish himself as a consistent starter. The Bianconeri have several defensive options who have featured more regularly lately, leaving Gatti with fewer opportunities to demonstrate his abilities. Although the club would like to retain him, his desire to play regularly could complicate their plans. Gatti’s future at Juventus becomes uncertain Luciano Spalletti has other defenders available whom he has preferred in recent weeks, and Gatti has consequently found himself on the fringes of the team. The situation could eventually push the Italian towards the exit, particularly if his playing time does not improve. According to La Gazzetta dello Sport , Gatti rejected opportunities to leave Juventus last summer, but his position has now changed. The report suggests that the defender is increasingly open to considering a departure when the transfer window reopens. His reduced involvement has created uncertainty about his long-term future in Turin. Juventus may appreciate his contribution to the dressing room, but retaining a player who wants a more prominent role could prove difficult if the club cannot offer him the minutes he expects. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images) Italy ambitions could influence his decision Gatti’s lack of regular football has also affected his international prospects. The defender wants to revive his Italy career, but securing a place in the national team becomes more challenging when he is not playing consistently at club level. A move away from Juventus could therefore become an increasingly attractive option if it offers him the opportunity to feature more regularly. Playing time is likely to be an important consideration as he weighs up his future.

item.title: How to watch Lions vs. Packers: TV, streaming, radio, more
item.description: Dec 5, 2024; Detroit, Michigan, USA; Detroit Lions quarterback Jared Goff (16) tries an unsuccessful quarterback sneak for a touchdown against the Green Bay Packers in the second quarter at Ford Field. Mandatory Credit: Lon Horwedel-Imagn Images | USA TODAY Sports via Reuters Con The Detroit Lions (3-2) and Green Bay Packers (4-2) face off on Sunday afternoon for a huge NFC North showdown. The division is one of the most competitive in the NFL and both the Packers and Lions are looking up at the Chicago Bears (5-2) and Minnesota Vikings (5-0). Lions vs. Packers is always must-see TV, but with the stakes even higher, you won’t want to miss this one. Here’s everything you need to know to watch the huge Week 7 matchup. When is the Lions vs. Packers? The game is on Sunday, October 25 at 4:25 p.m. ET. Where is the game being played? The Lions are back at home for their third home game of the season, at Ford Field in downtown Detroit. What TV channel is Lions vs. Packers on? The game is being broadcast on FOX this week. Is Lions vs. Packers playing in my part of the country? Almost certainly, yes! Lions vs. Packers is FOX’s game of the week, and is being broadcast to nearly all of the Unites States. You can see the broadcast map here via 506 Sports , but as long as you’re not in the local area for Rams vs. Raiders, you should have the game available to you on your local FOX channel. Where can I chat during the game? Look for our live game chat article, which will launch about an hour before kickoff (3:25 p.m. ET). The chat is best experienced through the SB Nation app! You can download the SB Nation app here: Join Pride of Detroit on game day! Stay on top of every Lions update and debate every snap with other members of One Pride. Game-day discussion is smoother in the SB Nation app. Fewer ads Jump easily between conversations Faster commenting and posting Download on iOS or Android . Can I stream the game? Yes! If you’re in the local area, you can watch the game online with an NFL+ subscription. Who are the TV announcers for Lions vs. Packers? The Lions are getting the top FOX broadcast crew of Kevin Burkhardt, Tom Brady, Erin Andrews, and Tom Rinaldi. Radio options for Lions vs. Packers game? For the local broadcast, Dan Miller is back with Lomas Brown over on 97.1 The Ticket or whatever Lions Radio Network affiliate is available in your area . Nationally, Compass Media Network is covering the game with Gregg Daniels and Brian Baldinger on the call. Or, if you want all of that information condensed: Lions vs. Packers game information: When: Sunday, October 25, 2026 — 4:25 p.m. ET Where: Ford Field — Detroit, MI TV: FOX TV announcers: Kevin Burkhardt, Tom Brady, Erin Andrews, and Tom Rinaldi NFL Week y broadcast map: Via 506 Sports Online streaming : Locally — NFL+ Live game chat: Available on the SB Nation app: Apple Store Google Play Store Local radio: 97.1 The Ticket ( Local affiliates here ) Local radio announcers: Dan Miller, Lomas Brown National

item.title: Troy Aikman could join Cowboys front office, but Jerry Jones would remain in charge
item.description: Troy Aikman could find a new role with the Dallas Cowboys if his broadcasting career at ESPN ends in 2027. However, any potential front-office position would likely leave owner Jerry Jones firmly in control of the franchise. Speaking on Pro Football Talk, Mike Florio discussed the possibility of Aikman transitioning from television to an NFL executive role. The Hall of Fame quarterback has expressed interest in working in a front office for years. “The Cowboys would make sense,” Florio said. “The question is how much power, influence, and say Jerry and Stephen Jones would be willing to give Aikman.” MORE: Ex-NFLer raises possibility of Troy Aikman leaving ESPN before Super Bowl Florio believes Aikman would not replace Jones as general manager. Jones has held that title for decades and remains central to the organization’s football decisions. “They’re not going to make him the GM,” Florio said. “Jerry is the GM. He made himself the GM 37 years ago, and he’s never going to fire himself or relinquish that title.” Instead, Aikman could receive a position such as assistant general manager. “If Aikman were to go there, he might get a title like assistant GM,” Florio said. That would allow the former Cowboys quarterback to contribute without displacing the existing leadership structure. Troy Aikman’s broadcasting future remains uncertain Canton, OH, USA; Troy Aikman arrives on the red carpet for the 2023 Pro Football Hall of Fame Enshrinement at Tom Benson Hall of Fame Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Kirby Lee-USA TODAY Sports Credit: USA TODAY Sports via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Aikman’s ESPN contract is approaching its end, creating questions about his next career move. His future has also attracted attention amid reports of tension with longtime broadcasting partner Joe Buck. If Aikman leaves television, Dallas could offer a natural destination. He won three Super Bowls with the Cowboys and remains one of the most prominent figures in franchise history. Aikman has also recently indicated his interest in helping the organization. Earlier, he told Mike Fisher that he “would welcome any conversation with Jerry.” “ Quite honestly, I don’t know if there ever would be an opportunity ,” Aikman said. “But if Jerry came to me and felt in his heart that I could lend some services that would help make [the Cowboys] better, I would have a hard time not taking a good look at that.” That possibility has gained attention as Dallas struggles through a disappointing 2026 season. The Cowboys entered their bye week with a 2-4 record, increasing scrutiny on head coach Brian Schottenheimer and the team’s leadership. MORE: Stephen A. Smith blasts Cowboys’ Brian Schottenheimer for claiming he’s a ‘great coach’ However, joining the front office would not necessarily give Aikman the authority to reshape the franchise. Jones and his son, executive vice president Stephen Jones, would likely retain significant control over personnel decisions. Aikman’s potential arrival could bring

He made himself the GM 37 years ago, and he’s never going to fire himself or relinquish that title.” Instead, Aikman could receive a position such as assistant general manager. “If Aikman were to go there, he might get a title like assistant GM,” Florio said. That would allow the former Cowboys quarterback to contribute without displacing the existing leadership structure. Troy Aikman’s broadcasting future remains uncertain Canton, OH, USA; Troy Aikman arrives on the red carpet for the 2023 Pro Football Hall of Fame Enshrinement at Tom Benson Hall of Fame Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Kirby Lee-USA TODAY Sports Credit: USA TODAY Sports via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Aikman’s ESPN contract is approaching its end, creating questions about his next career move. His future has also attracted attention amid reports of tension with longtime broadcasting partner Joe Buck. If Aikman leaves television, Dallas could offer a natural destination. He won three Super Bowls with the Cowboys and remains one of the most prominent figures in franchise history. Aikman has also recently indicated his interest in helping the organization. Earlier, he told Mike Fisher that he “would welcome any conversation with Jerry.” “ Quite honestly, I don’t know if there ever would be an opportunity ,” Aikman said. “But if Jerry came to me and felt in his heart that I could lend some services that would help make [the Cowboys] better, I would have a hard time not taking a good look at that.” That possibility has gained attention as Dallas struggles through a disappointing 2026 season. The Cowboys entered their bye week with a 2-4 record, increasing scrutiny on head coach Brian Schottenheimer and the team’s leadership. MORE: Stephen A. Smith blasts Cowboys’ Brian Schottenheimer for claiming he’s a ‘great coach’ However, joining the front office would not necessarily give Aikman the authority to reshape the franchise. Jones and his son, executive vice president Stephen Jones, would likely retain significant control over personnel decisions. Aikman’s potential arrival could bring valuable football insight, but the central question remains how much influence Dallas would actually give him. — Enjoy free coverage of the top news & trending stories with The Big Lead Newsletter —

item.title: Serie A official line-ups: Inter vs. Fiorentina
item.description: Serie A official line-ups: Inter vs. Fiorentina Ivan Provedel makes his Inter debut in a Serie A match against Fiorentina, with Francesco Pio Esposito and Marcus Thuram starting up front, while the Tuscans look to Mateo Pellegrino. It kicks off at 12:30 CET [11:30 GMT] at the Stadio Meazza in San Siro, Milan. Follow the build-up and live action on the FOOTBALL ITALIA LIVE BLOG MILAN, ITALY – OCTOBER 13: Marcus Thuram of FC Internazionale Milano clears the ball under pressure from Jan Virgili of Club Brugge KV during the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD2 match between FC Internazionale Milano and Club Brugge KV at Stadio San Siro on October 13, 2026 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) The Nerazzurri need a win to catch Lazio at the top of the Serie A table after the Biancocelesti beat Parma 2-1 on Saturday night. Inter are without the injured John Stones , Curtis Jones, Lautaro Martinez, Benjamin Pavard and Luis Henrique, while Fiorentina have travelled to Milan without Fabiano Parisi, Arthur Atta and Luca Ranieri. Cristian Chivu picks Pio Esposito and Thuram up front, while Andy Diouf returns to the starting XI at right midfield, so Djed Spence starts on the bench. MADRID, SPAIN – SEPTEMBER 08: Vinicius Junior of Real Madrid is challenged by Andy Diouf of Internazionale during the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD1 match between Real Madrid C.F. and FC Internazionale Milano at Estadio Santiago Bernabeu on September 08, 2026 in Madrid, Spain. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) Ivan Provedel makes his debut in goal, replacing Josep Martinez. Federico Dimarco rests, so Carlos Augusto starts on the left wing. The Brazilian has scored four goals and provided two in eight games across all competitions this season. Argentine centre-forward Pellegrino starts up front for the Tuscans, while Marco Brescianini joins Cher Ndour and Nicolò Fagioli in central midfield. FLORENCE, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 20: Head coach Paolo Vanoli manager of ACF Fiorentina reacts anf Franco Mastantuono of ACF Fiorentina during the Serie A match between ACF Fiorentina and SSC Napoli at Stadio Artemio Franchi on September 20, 2026 in Florence, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images) Inter remain unbeaten in Serie A this season, with six wins and one draw, and have earned four points so far, though they have lost three of their last five games. Inter vs. Fiorentina – official line-ups Inter (3-5-2): Provedel; Bisseck, Akanji, Bastoni; Diouf, Barella, Calhanoglu, Mkhitaryan, Carlos Augusto; Thuram, Esposito. Fiorentina (4-3-3): De Gea; Jimenez, Dragusin, Pongracic, Valdepenas; Ndour, Fagioli, Brescianini; Mastantuono, Pellegrino, Njie.

item.title: SEC Football Power Rankings: Kentucky climbs after Week 8 upsets
item.description: College football continues to be wild each week, and Week 8 was no different. Several teams in the Top 25 suffered losses, including No. 2 BYU, which was shocked by UCF in a 39-31 double-overtime victory for the Knights. Cincinnati also pulled off an upset against No. 8 Texas Tech, earning a 37-24 win at home. Meanwhile, No. 11 Tennessee fell to unranked South Carolina on the road, 27-24, while No. 19 Texas upset No. 7 Ole Miss at home, 34-27. There were plenty of other surprises across the country, but those were among the biggest results of the weekend. With so many ranked teams falling, Kentucky could be in line to move into the top 10 of the AP Top 25 after defeating Vanderbilt, 34-17, inside Kroger Field. With all of that in mind, let’s get into the rankings. SEC Football Power Rankings Week 9 No. 1 Georgia Bulldogs (6-1, 4-1) Georgia stays at No. 1 despite having a bye week. The Bulldogs are coming off a heartbreaking 27-23 loss to Auburn at home, but they remain one of the best teams in the SEC. Despite having one loss on their record, Georgia has shown enough throughout the season to maintain the top spot. The Bulldogs will have an opportunity to get back on track as they prepare for their next matchup. No. 2 Kentucky Wildcats (7-1, 5-1) Kentucky continues to show that no matter what happens early in a game, the Wildcats will keep fighting and find ways to win. That has been evident throughout the season, including their comeback from a 17-0 deficit against South Carolina to win 35-34. The Wildcats did it again this past weekend, overcoming an early 10-0 deficit against Vanderbilt to secure a 34-17 victory. Kentucky’s defense once again played a significant role in the comeback by forcing turnovers and helping the team regain control of the game. If Kentucky’s offense can put together a complete performance for four quarters, this team could become even more dangerous. With seven wins and an impressive resume under first-year head coach Will Stein, the Wildcats deserve to move up to No. 2 in the SEC Power Rankings. No. 3 LSU Tigers (6-2, 3-2) LSU has been impressive under first-year head coach Lane Kiffin. While some may consider the season disappointing with two losses already on the schedule, the Tigers have faced difficult challenges along the way. One of those losses came against Kiffin’s former team, Ole Miss, in an emotional matchup. The other came on the road against Kentucky, where the Wildcats’ fans created a difficult environment and helped make things challenging for LSU in an overtime defeat. Despite those setbacks, the Tigers bounced back in a big way by taking care of business against Auburn on the road, earning a 38-14 victory. If LSU can continue to build momentum, it has the potential to remain one of the SEC’s top teams. item.title: Billion-Dollar Ballers: Two New Athletes Hit $1 Billion In Career Earnings
item.description: After Tiger Woods became the first active athlete ever to surpass $1 billion in career earnings in 2009 , it took another eight years for anyone to match that achievement, with boxer Floyd Mayweather finally clearing that bar in 2017 . The club isn’t quite as exclusive anymore. With more money flowing into sports than ever before, nine athletes have now reached at least $1 billion in cumulative cash income—including on-field earnings like salaries and prize money as well as off-field earnings like endorsement deals, without deducting for taxes or agents’ fees—and another two are on track to join that group within the next year. Basketball stars Stephen Curry and Kevin Durant are the most recent additions, each crossing $1 billion during the 2025-26 season. With Curry and Durant expected to make $203.6 million and $104.9 million, respectively, as the NBA’s two highest-paid players in 2026-27, they are poised to leapfrog past Mayweather, Roger Federer and Phil Mickelson into fifth and sixth place on the all-time financial leaderboard by the spring. The top four will be harder to crack. This year, Cristiano Ronaldo became the first active athlete ever to hit $2 billion in career earnings, with his playing salary reaching a new stratosphere after his move to the Saudi Pro League’s Al Nassr in 2023 and his endorsement portfolio ranking among the most lucrative in all of sports . The 41-year-old soccer legend is set to extend his lead at No. 1 with another $300 million payday this season that would push his lifetime total to $2.39 billion. Forbes Ronaldo’s longtime rival Lionel Messi should join him in the multibillion club by next year, however, along with Woods, who still earns an estimated $45 million annually off the course even as injuries have kept him from teeing off much in recent years. LeBron James is fourth, with $1.68 billion in career earnings to date, and although he accepted a meager-by-his-standards $3.9 million salary for this season to compete for a championship with the Philadelphia 76ers in the twilight of his career, he is making an estimated $90 million from a deep roster of partners and other business endeavors. The top four also share another distinction as the only active athletes to have become billionaires. (While Mickelson, Federer, Mayweather, Durant and Curry have all exceeded $1 billion in career earnings, Forbes estimates that their net worths fall short of $1 billion after accounting for taxes, agent fees and other expenses.) item.content:encoded: After Tiger Woods became the first active athlete ever to surpass $1 billion in career earnings in 2009 , it took another eight years for anyone to match that achievement, with boxer Floyd Mayweather finally clearing that bar in 2017 . The club isn’t quite as exclusive anymore. With more money flowing into sports than ever before, nine athletes have now reached at least $1 billion in cumulative cash income—including on-field earnings like salaries and prize money as well as off-field earnings like endorsement deals, without deducting for taxes or agents’ fees—and another two are on track to join that group within the next year. Basketball stars Stephen Curry and Kevin Durant are the most recent additions, each crossing $1 billion during the 2025-26 season. With Curry and Durant expected to make $203.6 million and $104.9 million, respectively, as the NBA’s two highest-paid players in 2026-27, they are poised to leapfrog past Mayweather, Roger Federer and Phil Mickelson into fifth and sixth place on the all-time financial leaderboard by the spring. The top four will be harder to crack. This year, Cristiano Ronaldo became the first active athlete ever to hit $2 billion in career earnings, with his playing salary reaching a new stratosphere after his move to the Saudi Pro League’s Al Nassr in 2023 and his endorsement portfolio ranking among the most lucrative in all of sports . The 41-year-old soccer legend is set to extend his lead at No. 1 with another $300 million payday this season that would push his lifetime total to $2.39 billion. Forbes Ronaldo’s longtime rival Lionel Messi should join him in the multibillion club by next year, however, along with Woods, who still earns an estimated $45 million annually off the course even as injuries have kept him from teeing off much in recent years. LeBron James is fourth, with $1.68 billion in career earnings to date, and although he accepted a meager-by-his-standards $3.9 million salary for this season to compete for a championship with the Philadelphia 76ers in the twilight of his career, he is making an estimated $90 million from a deep roster of partners and other business endeavors. The top four also share another distinction as the only active athletes to have become billionaires. (While Mickelson, Federer, Mayweather, Durant and Curry have all exceeded $1 billion in career earnings, Forbes estimates that their net worths fall short of $1 billion after accounting for taxes, agent fees and other expenses.) Meanwhile, Michael Jordan, the world’s richest ex-athlete , with an estimated $4.7 billion net worth , is absent from the all-time earnings list because Forbes is including only the compensation that came while athletes were active in their sports. Most of the cash His Airness has hauled in from his Jordan Brand and other sponsors—not to mention his $3 billion sale of the Charlotte Hornets in 2023—has come after he retired. In fact, Jordan collected just $94 million in playing salary across his entire NBA career, without adjusting for inflation—a total eclipsed by today’s NBA stars in less than two years of work. In many ways, though, the 21st century’s sports stars can thank Jordan for creating a blueprint of how to parlay their celebrity and on-court success into profitable personal brands. In 1984, when Nike was still an upstart in the apparel industry, the company gambled an unprecedented $2.5 million over five years on Jordan, plus a royalty on every pair of shoes it sold. This year, Curry signed a deal with Chinese brand Li-Ning that is reportedly worth $400 million over ten years . It is no coincidence, either, that by the end of this season, five of the top six earners ever will be basketball and soccer players. The NBA’s current ten highest-paid players are expected to rake in $958 million this season, edging the world’s highest-paid soccer players at $942 million and demolishing the top ten in every other sport. But while the NBA is benefiting from an 11-year, $76 billion media rights package that is driving up the league’s salary cap, it will take a few more years for the next generation of stars—such as Giannis Antetokounmpo, Anthony Edwards and Jayson Tatum—to join James, Curry and Durant in the billion-dollar club at their current pace. It will sadly be even longer before a woman lands among the highest-paid athletes of all-time. Serena Williams amassed roughly $450 million in estimated income before stepping away from tennis in 2022, putting her more than $100 million ahead of any other female athlete ever, and the world’s highest-paid female athlete last year was Coco Gauff at $33 million—one-ninth of what her male counterpart, Ronaldo, pocketed. Still, there are two athletes due to reach ten figures in the coming months: soccer icon Neymar, whose playing salary tumbled with his 2025 move to Santos in his native Brazil but whose estimated endorsement estimates continue to top $20 million annually, and Formula 1 driver Lewis Hamilton, whose estimated $100 million in income last year put him in pole position to overtake the $1 billion threshold, with about $940 million in his career to date. The Highest-Paid Athletes Of All-Time Fadel Senna/AFP/Getty Images #1. Cristiano Ronaldo Career Earnings: $2.09 billion Sport: Soccer Age: 41 Projected Earnings Through 2027: $2.39 billion Entrenched at the top of Forbes’ list of the world’s highest-paid athletes for the last four years thanks to a contract with Saudi Arabia’s Al Nassr that pays him more than $200 million annually, Ronaldo is playing his tenth straight season with at least $100 million in estimated earnings—a streak that also spans his stints with Manchester United, Juventus and Real Madrid. The 41-year-old Portuguese forward has 679 million followers on Instagram, the most of any person in the world, and in a career marked by unprecedented individual milestones, he has one more on the horizon as he closes in on scoring 1,000 goals in club and international competition. In June, Ronaldo made his debut on Forbes’ list of the world’s billionaires with an estimated net worth of $1.2 billion, edging his longtime rival Lionel Messi at $1.1 billion . James Gilbert/TGL Golf/Getty Images #2. Tiger Woods Career Earnings: $1.97 billion Sport: Golf Age: 50 Projected Earnings Through 2027: $2.01 billion During Woods’ heyday, he was the world’s highest-paid athlete for a decade straight, bringing in more than $100 million per year through the late 2000s. Earning his second billion has proved to be a much bumpier ride, after a 2009 infidelity scandal and a 2026 arrest on suspicion of drunk driving tarnished his public image and a series of injuries and back surgeries halted his dominance on the course. Woods also lost a major sponsor in 2024 when he and Nike parted ways after 27 years together, but he has maintained relationships with TaylorMade, Bridgestone and Monster Energy, among other partners, while launching his own apparel brand , Sun Day Red. Woods joined Forbes’ billionaires list in 2022, the week after LeBron James , and now has an estimated net worth of $1.5 billion. Johnnie Izquierdo/Getty Images #3. Lionel Messi Career Earnings: $1.87 billion Sport: Soccer Age: 39 Projected Earnings Through 2027: $2.02 billion Messi reportedly had an offer on the table from the Saudi Pro League that would have paid him $400 million per year after his contract with Paris Saint-Germain expired in 2023, but he took a different route than his rival Cristiano Ronaldo and joined Major League Soccer’s Inter Miami instead. The move has supercharged the club’s business, sending its valuation soaring to an MLS-best $1.35 billion , and Messi is making out fine with an estimated $145 million in income this year, including the proceeds from what are believed to be revenue-sharing agreements with league sponsors Adidas and Apple TV. England batting updates England: 159/5 after 30 overs Excellent knock from Ben Duckett under pressure as he is closing on his century. England are back in the game. Toss result: Pakistan won the toss and opted to field first. Pre-match: Pakistan began the ODI tri-series strongly as they won both their first-round matches against Sri Lanka and England and at the moment they are favourites to reach the final of the Tri-series. They kicked off the contest with a 37-run win over Sri Lanka, after which they thrashed England by 87 runs. One more win against Harry Brook's side on Sunday will seal the hosts' berth in the final. item.description: Where to watch NASCAR today: Channel, time, TV schedule, live stream for 2026 Talladega playoff race originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . With only three races left in the season, the NASCAR Cup Series Playoff will face a wild card this weekend at Talladega. Fans, get ready for the YellaWood 400. Out of the 10 events that make up NASCAR's Playoff Chase, Sunday's will require the most luck by far. Talladega Superspeedway is known to be chaotic, with multi-line drafts and side-by-side racing at nearly 200mph that always makes for some precarious conditions. With the uncertainty of this track, it's completely possible that an underdog could secure a clutch win. There are certain drivers that have been more successful at Talladega though, including three-time winner Ryan Blaney, and this year's spring event winner Carson Hocevar. You won't want to miss out on all the mayhem. Here's everything you need to know about the YellaWood 400, including TV channel and streaming options for the NASCAR Playoff race. item.title: NFL games on TV today: Full schedule, times, channels, live streams to watch Sunday Week 7
item.description: NFL games on TV today: Full schedule, times, channels, live streams to watch Sunday Week 7 originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Week 7 of the NFL season is here, with another long Sunday schedule on tap. The day starts in Paris, where the game between the Steelers and Saints at the Stade de France is set to go on amid heavy security despite unrest that has plagued the city in recent weeks. In the early afternoon window, Eastern time, the 49ers try to stay unbeaten as they travel to face the Falcons , and the Vikings will do the same at home against the Colts , while the Dolphins will be looking for their first win as they meet the Jets . A pair of divisional games might be the highlight of the afternoon slate, though, with the Ravens hosting the Bengals in the early slot and the Lions facing the Packers in a near-national game later. The nightcap is a matchup of the teams that have won three of the last four Super Bowls as the Chiefs try to stay perfect in a tough game at Seattle. A full day of action is on tap. item.title: BREAKING: Courtois out against Barcelona
item.description: Real Madrid have announced that goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois will not play against FC Barcelona tonight. Per Realmadrid.com Courtois is a last-minute drop due to a flu process for tonight’s match between Real Madrid and Barcelona, corresponding to the tenth round of the League. Illia Voloshyn enters the squad list in his place. This is devastating news for Real Madrid. item.title: Is there a World Series game today? Full TV schedule, times, channels for Brewers vs. Rays Game 3
item.description: Is there a World Series game today? Full TV schedule, times, channels for Brewers vs. Rays Game 3 originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . After a pair of agonizing losses in Milwaukee, the Rays will look to turn the World Series around as they return to Florida for Game 3. The Brewers rallied from a 4-0 first-inning deficit in Game 2, chipping away at the Tampa Bay pitching staff while their bullpen put up six scoreless innings before Cooper Pratt singled in the go-ahead run in the seventh for a 5-4 win. item.title: ‘Dumbest person I ever worked with’: Keith Olbermann does not hold back on ESPN colleague Sage Steele
item.description: Keith Olbermann and Sage Steele Former ESPN anchor Sage Steele has found herself in the middle of a growing controversy surrounding Life Surge, a Christian organization that has been accused of running a predatory business model. Despite the controversy surrounding the organization, Steele has continued to appear at the group’s events, even as other prominent sports figures like Tim Tebow have distanced themselves. As a result, former ESPN host Keith Olbermann, Steele’s former colleague, blasted her on social media this week, saying that she has somehow become “more stupid” and “more corrupt” and once again calling her the dumbest person he has ever worked with. The Life Surge Controversy Last month, Pablo Torre Finds Out took a deep look at Life Surge , which holds events around the country featuring athletes, TV personalities, and other speakers. Tickets to the events typically cost about $30. But Torre reported that the events are designed to funnel attendees into classes on stock trading and real estate, with mentorship programs that can cost as much as $50,000. To make matters worse, third-party brokers reportedly helped attendees apply for credit cards with temporary 0% interest rates, and some people were encouraged to borrow against their homes and retirement accounts After the report, Tebow said he was pausing his relationship with the organization. Boston Celtics head coach Joe Mazzulla also distanced himself from the group. Steele, however, has continued her relationship with the organization. Steele Continues With Life Surge In a new episode of his show, Torre showed footage of Steele speaking at a Life Surge event in Charlotte, North Carolina, on Oct. 10 – weeks after his report exposing the organization. In her speech, Steele spoke about “cancellation” and “losing friendships” as a result of her beliefs. “Cancellation is real. Losing paychecks is real. Losing friendships is real,” Steele told the crowd, via Awful Announcing . “But I can tell you through personal experience that what can come on the other side is beautiful.” Steele was pulled off the air at ESPN in 2021 after controversial comments about the company’s vaccine mandate, and she later settled a lawsuit with the network in 2023. According to Torre, his show has been exchanging messages with Steele’s representatives since before the first episode aired. But Steele has not responded to any of his questions about the allegations against Life Surge. ‘More Stupid Or More Corrupt’ Needless to say, Olbermann was not impressed by his former colleague’s continued involvement with Life Surge or her recent comments. In fact, he doubled down on calling her “the dumbest person I ever worked with.” “I have to confess I didn’t think @sagesteele could get more stupid or more corrupt – yet here we are,” Olbermann wrote on X . “Dumbest person I ever worked with. Steve Roah levels of dumb (deep cut, KTLA 1985-86),” he added. This is not the first time Olbermann has had such blunt words for

item.title: Why Mikel Arteta is right about Max Dowman
item.description: Why Mikel Arteta is right about Max Dowman Mikel Arteta has faced some pushback on his recent comments about Max Dowman, but the Arsenal manager was right to suggest that what the 16-year-old is doing is unique. Photo by Julian Finney/Getty Images Speaking ahead of Arsenal’s game against Everton , Mikel Arteta was asked about how much harder it is for a player like Max Dowman to break through at 16 years old in England, compared to other leagues in France, Spain, and so on. “Well, tell me how many 16-year-olds have played in the last hundred years at this level,” Arteta said. “It’s simple, there aren’t any, zero. There isn’t a single player. That’s why he’s unique.” The reporter then put forward Wayne Rooney , to which Arteta responded: “But every three days, I’m playing Champions League, I’m playing… It wasn’t. So that’s the level.” Photo by Alex Pantling/Getty Images Many on social media have suggested that Dowman’s appearances aren’t unique, because Rooney also played in the Premier League at 16, along with Aaron Lennon . But there are significant differences between Dowman’s situation and theirs. As Arteta points out, the primary difference is that Dowman is also playing in the Champions League, and the FA Cup, and the League Cup. Rooney played 10 senior games in all competitions before his 17th birthday, and Lennon played 13. But Dowman has played 17 times already, including four Champions League appearances to Rooney and Lennon’s zero. That comparison also ignores that Dowman isn’t 17 yet. He was exactly 16 and 297 days old when he made his 17th Arsenal appearance on Saturday. At 16 and 297 days old, Rooney made his Everton debut against Tottenham Hotspur . So at exactly the same age, Dowman is 16 games ahead. Photo by Justin Setterfield/Getty Images Looking at the Premier League alone, Dowman still has a little bit more to do before he can take the overall record. Rooney played nine times before turning 17, and Lennon played 10 times. Dowman is at eight appearances. But again, Dowman has more than two months before his 17th birthday, and he only needs to make two appearances to match the Premier League record, or three to take it outright. When you include the Champions League, and the fact Dowman is playing for the Premier League champions (not Everton or Leeds United), Arteta is absolutely correct. No one has done what the Arsenal teenager is doing. Photo by Alex Pantling/Getty Images

item.title: 'I get mad': Tyrese Maxey says he becomes so angry when VJ Edgecombe stops doing one thing for 76ers
item.description: Photo by Mitchell Leff/Getty Images VJ Edgecombe was in fine form as the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Milwaukee Bucks 127-116 to go 3-0 in the NBA this season. The Sixers rested LeBron James on Saturday night, but that didn’t seem to weaken them at all. Joel Embiid was the star of the show, while Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown continued their fine form. But Edgecombe’s contribution may have just been the reason why Philly won the game, and Maxey is not surprised at all. Tyrese Maxey says he gets mad when VJ Edgecombe doesn’t do what he always does The 76ers seemed to be in control for large parts of the game, but there was a moment when the Bucks looked like they were mounting a comeback. Philly had a 16-point lead at one point, but that was cut down to three with just over two minutes left on the clock. It was getting a bit nervy. However, Edgecombe produced a remarkable minute and a half. In 1:33 of game time, he had one steal, one block, one assist and two rebounds, and the Sixers went on to win the game by 11 points. After the game, Maxey was asked if he was surprised by Edgecombe’s performance. He said no and claimed that he gets mad when the 21-year-old doesn’t do what he did against the Bucks. He told reporters: “I’m surprised when he doesn’t do it. I get mad at him and call it, ‘Hey, go do that VJ stuff you do! That’s what I call.’” Edgecombe, still only 21, is a phenomenal talent, and he has shown more than once this season that he belongs at the highest level. With superstars like James and Embiid helping him behind the scenes, we are convinced Edgecombe is destined for greatness. All he needs to do is continue working hard and he will get there. item.title: Confirmed: Real Madrid suffer major last-minute blow as Thibaut Courtois ruled out of El Clasico
item.description: Confirmed: Real Madrid suffer major last-minute blow as Thibaut Courtois ruled out of El Clasico Real Madrid have suffered a major setback just hours before their highly anticipated El Clasico against Barcelona. In an eleventh-hour development, Jose Mourinho will be without first-choice goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois. The Belgium international’s absence comes as a huge blow to Real Madrid’s aspirations of closing the six-point gap to Barcelona. Real Madrid confirm Courtois’ absence In an official statement released on Sunday , Real Madrid confirmed that Courtois will miss the match due to a bout of flu. The club also announced that young Ukrainian goalkeeper Illia Voloshyn has been called into the squad as his replacement. This leaves Mourinho without one of his most reliable performers for a fixture that could have a serious effect on the title race. Thibaut Courtois will be a huge miss for Real Madrid. (Photo by Tullio M. Puglia/Getty Images) Courtois’ ability to produce crucial saves in high-pressure matches has been invaluable to Madrid over the years, and he tends to step up in such games . Now, with the Belgian unavailable, Madrid will have their work cut out to stop the fearsome Barcelona attack from finding the back of the net. Mourinho faces a difficult goalkeeping decision With Courtois unavailable, Andriy Lunin is the natural candidate to take his place between the posts. The Ukraine international has experience stepping into the spotlight for Madrid and could slot comfortably into the XI. Lamine Yamal, Raphinha and Anthony Gordon could look to pepper the goal, and Barça ‘s tendency to press high means Lunin will have to be secure with the ball at his feet. Courtois’ absence could also affect Madrid’s defensive structure. His commanding presence and shot-stopping ability offer reassurance to the players in front of him. Andriy Lunin is expected to start against Barcelona in Courtois’ absence. (Photo by Christian Bruna/Getty Images) With Lunin replacing the Belgian, Ibrahima Konate and the other defenders will need to organise the defence better. Courtois’ absence is undoubtedly a significant blow, but Madrid still have the quality to compete. While it makes the task at hand much more difficult, it is something Los Blancos should figure out if they aspire to compete for La Liga this season. Ultimately, much will depend on how Mourinho’s side protect their backup goalkeeper and limit Barcelona’s attacking opportunities, and it remains to be seen how Lunin fares.
